angles.label: PMP July 9 exam flip to 60% agile
angles.source: PMI announcement + cert-prep coverage (PM Mastery, ProjectManagementAcademy, examcert)
angles.outlierSignal: Topic-hot (Reddit/X metrics not verifiable via search). Business Environment domain tripling 8% → 26%.
angles.whyHot: 6 weeks until cutoff; experienced predictive PMs are spooked by agile-weighted scenarios.
angles.angleForBrad: Walk through one Business Environment scenario where the "obvious PM answer" is wrong under agile framing — AI shows why.

angles.label: SHRM 2026 BASK adds AI governance questions
angles.source: SHRM BASK PDF + Pocket Prep blog (⚠ competitor authored — handoff)
angles.outlierSignal: New "Inclusive Mindset" competency consolidates two old ones; AI risk-tradeoff scenarios now testable.
angles.whyHot: HR candidates feel blindsided by AI-evaluation questions outside their daily work.
angles.angleForBrad: Show a SHRM-CP AI governance scenario with three plausible answers — AI explains which "defensible" choice the rubric rewards.

angles.label: Security+ 701 vs SY0-801 decision fatigue
angles.outlierSignal: SY0-801 preview ~Oct 2026; 701 retires mid-2027. New objectives 2.4 (LLMs) and 2.6 (AI threats).
angles.whyHot: Candidates debating "test now on 701 vs. study 801 from scratch" — decision fatigue.
angles.angleForBrad: Frame CipherExam as the bridge — same reasoning engine works on 701 today, 801 when it drops; no re-buying a study tool.

skipThese: Generic "I passed the PMP!" celebration posts — high reach, zero nerve, no opening for the reasoning angle.
handoffNote: Pocket Prep is actively publishing on the 2026 SHRM BASK changes. cipher-competitor-analyst should review their angle before Brad drafts Angle 2.
honestyCaveat: WebSearch did not surface Reddit/X posts with verifiable upvote/repost counts for the 7-day window. Angles are confirmed topic-hot via PMI/CompTIA/SHRM official announcements and cert-prep publishers — not metric-confirmed Reddit outliers.
